# vibe-knowledge attribution

History director v2 acknowledges the code and design mechanisms in
[andyhuo520/vibe-knowledge](https://github.com/andyhuo520/vibe-knowledge/tree/c3a13a85f7cc560e5d396f063baecea4b2748e1e),
pinned to commit `c3a13a85f7cc560e5d396f063baecea4b2748e1e`.
Copyright (c) 2026 Berryxia (andyhuo520). Its code and documentation are MIT licensed;
the exact license notice is preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

The reviewed mechanisms include narration-anchored cues, deterministic absolute-time
animation, staged appearance and removal of objects, and onset/peak placement of
short sound effects. These are reimplemented in this project's validated Python
and Remotion data pipeline. No upstream JavaScript engine, executable prompt,
human-review workflow, MiMo voice, or voice-cloning system is installed by this integration.
MiniMax remains this project's narrator provider.

The History Pack SVG actors and props are original project drawings. All ten WAVs
in `assets/audio/history/` are original procedural synthesis with fixed seeds,
reproducible by `tools/build_history_resources.py`; no recordings or external
sound-bank samples are used. Their resource cards contain source hashes and
generation parameters. Natural Earth, Wikidata and the separately approved mural
retain their own existing provenance records and licenses.

No upstream sample film, poster, style-wall image, generated illustration, voice
reference, font, icon set, music file or third-party SFX is copied by this integration.
The user's BGM remains a user-supplied runtime input; preserving this MIT notice
does not grant new redistribution rights in that music or any other media.

Upstream media exclusions and third-party terms were checked at the same commit:

- [Upstream NOTICE.md](https://github.com/andyhuo520/vibe-knowledge/blob/c3a13a85f7cc560e5d396f063baecea4b2748e1e/NOTICE.md)
